name: ddl_no_exclusive_lock_lq1686_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1686 — runtime DDL must not take an exclusive lock to assert what is already true.
(symbol_profiles) ran CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS on every
process start / every scan / every lane run; IF NOT EXISTS suppresses the error, not the lock.
2026-11-09 14:18-15:19 ET: 124 lock timeouts, 5 deadlocks. All four now ask the catalog first
(lib.ddl_guard.relation_exists / column_exists, or an information_schema read where the module
already had one, no table lock) and issue DDL only for what is genuinely absent; the schema itself
The tests drive the real functions against a fake cursor that answers catalog reads the way PostgreSQL
would and records every statement: an up-to-date schema must execute no DDL, a missing column must still
be added (a guard that skips everything is worse than the lock). Fake IO: no database, no broker.
